metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Cuttack, Odisha decrease from April 30, 2019 to May 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about nighttime brightness in Cuttack, Odisha between April 30, 2019 and May 4, 2019. This requires: 1. Data: VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) data for nighttime brightness 2. Location: Cuttack, Odisha (need to define a point or small polygon) 3. Dates: April 30, 2019 and May 4, 2019 4. Processing: Compare average brightness values between the two dates Strategy: - Use VIIRS DNB data from NOAA-20 or Suomi NPP - Define Cuttack location (approx 20.4659°N, 85.8793°E) - Get images for both dates - Calculate mean brightness for each date - Compare values to see if decreased Potential issues: - Cloud cover might affect data quality - Need to check if images exist for both dates - Need to validate pixel counts - Ensure valid comparison (not None/NaN) For VIIRS DNB, I'll use the 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG' collection which has cloud-free composites, or the daily 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG' for daily data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cuttack = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8793, 20.4659]); const buffer = cuttack.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for regional average const date1 = '2019-04-30'; const date2 = '2019-05-04'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using VIIRS DNB monthly composites for better data quality const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterBounds(cuttack); // Get April 2019 composite (includes April 30) const april2019 = viirs.filterDate('2019-04-01', '2019-05-01').first(); // Get May 2019 composite (includes May 4) const may2019 = viirs.filterDate('2019-05-01', '2019-06-01').first(); // Check if images exist const aprilExists = april2019 ? true : false; const mayExists = may2019 ? true : false; if (!aprilExists || !mayExists) { console.log(`April 2019 image: ${aprilExists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log(`May 2019 image: ${mayExists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean brightness const aprilBrightness = april2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayBrightness = may2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const aprilCount = april2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayCount = may2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`April 30 brightness: ${aprilBrightness ? aprilBrightness.toFixed(4) : 'None'}`); console.log(`May 4 brightness: ${mayBrightness ? mayBrightness.toFixed(4) : 'None'}`); console.log(`April valid pixels: ${aprilCount}`); console.log(`May valid pixels: ${mayCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (aprilBrightness === null || mayBrightness === null || isNaN(aprilBrightness) || isNaN(mayBrightness)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (aprilCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mayBrightness < aprilBrightness) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
